profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Strengths:
•	Effective communicator
•	Quick learner and hardworking 
•	Self-motivated, organized and a real people person. 
•	Work well independently and as part of a team.

Skills:
•	Database System: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle 9i, 10g, 11g, Sybase	
•	Programming Languages:  C++, Delphi, Java / J2EE, JSP/Java Servlets, HTML, PL/SQL, SQL, Swing, UML , XML		
•	Software: Adobe Acrobat Reade, Eclipse, JBOSS, Microsoft Office Suite (Including MS Access),  Microsoft Visual C++
•	Process/Methodology: Agile, JAD, OOP, OOD, Waterfall.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Java · Oracle · PL/SQL · Web Development · SQL · Software Development

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
o	Ability to analyze the development process to improve efficiency and quality.
o	Ability to communicate necessary changes, needs, and/or recommendations to all management levels.
o	Ability to lead improvement of code standard and design practices, and professional development of the team.
o	Create time estimates for project using the PERT method.
o	Implement tablet module using the MVP architecture.
o	Work in a fast-paced development environment to create an AJAX web application using the Google Web Toolkit.
o	Work independent or with QA and other developers to improve the product or solve issues.

Technologies/Skills:  Apache Maven, CSS, Eclipse, GWT, HTML, IntelliJ, Java, JavaScript, MySQL, Python and XML.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Web Development · Agile Development · Query Writing · Back-End Web Development · Stored Procedures · Debugging · Computer Science · Query Optimization

positions.title: Programming Lead
positions.description:
Project FLMS
•	Assign and assist the design and coding phase of the SCR process, including establish timelines/plan and LOE/durations.
•	Provide mentorship to the programming team regarding the application specific technical and business logic matters.
•	Refresh Oracle development database schemas.
•	Responsible to create builds (full/interim/patches) and push them through the build process.
•	Responsible for the development of functions, packages, store procedures, sequence, table, triggers, user defined datatype and views,  
•	Serve as an interface between the programmers and management and have supervisorial responsibilities in delegating work and ensuring that software projects come in on time and under budget
•	Serve as technical advisers to management and provide programming perspective on requirements

Technologies/Skills:   Delphi 5, PL/SQL, Oracle 10g, Oracle 11g
positions.insights: Skills: Federal Contracts · Query Writing · Back-End Web Development · Stored Procedures · Debugging · Computer Science · Query Optimization

positions.title: Application Programmer II
positions.description:
Project FLMS
•	Design, develop, code, test, debug and document software programs
•	Developing existing programs by analyzing and identifying areas for modification
•	Manage software development and support using formal specifications, data flow diagrams, and other acceptable design techniques
•	Perform all tasks necessary to maintain and update databases with data acquired from customer or other systems
•	Interpret software requirements and design specifications in order to code, integrate, and test software programs that meet customer requirements
•	Review existing programs and assist in making refinements, optimizations, and enhancements using software engineering practices and techniques
•	Perform duties as an integrated product team member working with various disciplines and skills sets to reach decisions and produce a product in a specified timeline.
•	Understanding of FLMS functionality and the ability to analyze and evaluate application and customer requirements.

Technologies/Skills:   Delphi 5, PL/SQL, Oracle 9i, Oracle 10g, Sybase.
positions.insights: Skills: Federal Contracts · Query Writing · Back-End Web Development · Stored Procedures · Debugging · Computer Science · Query Optimization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project FLMS
	Responsibilities:
o	Fixed bug and solved the production issues in very short time period
o	Shared the experience with other team members
o	Developed enhancements to meet the deadlines
o	Refactored existing codes, making system more efficient/better performance

Technologies/Skills:   Delphi 5, Sybase.

Project AIMMS
Responsibilities:
o	Analyzed and develop solution requirements scope
o	Developed data models and process flows in support of application micro design
o	Developed database schema and application user interface (UI)
o	Developed software development through reverse-engineer
o	Developed solution documentation and provide end-user training

Technologies/Skills:   Eclipse, Java, Java Servlet, JSP, JBoss, Netbeans, PL/SQL, PostgreSQL
